name: Simplex Mills Company Limited
about: Simplex Mills Company Limited trades in textile products in India. The company offers yarns and fabric products, such as grey belting fabrics, canvas cloth, cotton, and nylon. It also provides bleached, dyed, printed, wearable, and sheeting fabrics in cotton and blends. In addition, the company offers various fabrics, including oxford weave, twill weave, leno weave, and nylon fabrics. Further, it engages in the manufacture and supply of industrial cloths and cotton yarns. Simplex Mills Company Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Mumbai, India.
